# Alliance for Philadelphia Public Schools

> A grassroots organization of parents, community members, and school staff advocating for public education quality and accountability in Philadelphia.

APPS conducts research, provides analysis, and demands accountability from the School District of Philadelphia on critical issues including facilities planning, school closures, board governance, and educator rights. The organization mobilizes community testimony and advocacy at Board of Education meetings to defend public schools.

## Key Topics

- Philadelphia public schools
- School District of Philadelphia
- Facilities Master Plan
- School closures
- Board of Education

## Core Organization

- [Alliance for Philadelphia Public Schools](https://appsphilly.net): Homepage for APPS, a grassroots organization advocating for Philadelphia public schools
- [About](https://appsphilly.net/about): Mission statement and organization overview of Alliance for Philadelphia
- [Our Work](https://appsphilly.net/our-work): APPS research reports and advocacy work on school reform and charter schools

## Advocacy & Campaigns

- [Reckless Facilities Plan Will Devastate Philadelphia Communities](https://appsphilly.net/reckless-facilities-plan-will-devastate-philadelphia-communities): Community opposition to School District facilities plan and school closures with analysis by Haver and Grill
- [Board Members Silent on Facilities Plan, School Closings](https://appsphilly.net/board-members-silent-on-facilities-plan-school-closings): Analysis of board accountability and sunshine act violations during facilities plan discussions
- [Nobody Wants This, They Don't Care](https://appsphilly.net/nobody-wants-this-they-dont-care): Student and community advocacy against facilities plan at Board of Education meeting
- [Board Must Protect Constitutional Rights of Public School Educators](https://appsphilly.net/board-must-protect-constitutional-rights-of-public-school-educators): Board governance critique and educator rights advocacy by APPS
